cases.description: One looped SQL lookup contains both injection and N+1 query defects, while two agents describe the injection differently.

pull_request.title: Load users for a list of email addresses
pull_request.body: Add a batch lookup helper for repeated user lookups.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+def find_users(db, emails):
+    users = []
+    for email in emails:
+        query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '{email}'"
+        users.append(db.query(query).fetchone())
+    return users

expected_findings.description: The email value is interpolated into SQL and allows query injection.
Executing one user query per email creates an N+1 database access pattern.

cases.description: A single file-open expression creates distinct path traversal and resource lifecycle defects that must not be merged.

pull_request.title: Read an uploaded document
pull_request.body: Open an upload by its request filename and return its bytes.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+UPLOAD_ROOT = Path('/srv/uploads')
+
+def read_upload(filename):
+    handle = open(UPLOAD_ROOT / filename, 'rb')
+    return handle.read()

expected_findings.description: The unvalidated filename can escape the upload root through path traversal.
The opened upload file handle is never closed.

cases.description: A multi-file change combines an N+1 customer lookup with a duplicated shipping rule.

pull_request.title: Add order export and channel shipping helpers
pull_request.body: Load customer data for exported orders and add the same free-shipping rule for each sales channel.

@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+def export_orders(db):
+    rows = []
+    for order in db.query(Order).all():
+        customer = db.get(Customer, order.customer_id)
+        rows.append((order, customer))
+    return rows

@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+def web_free_shipping(total):
+    return total >= 100
+
+def mobile_free_shipping(total):
+    return total >= 100
+
+def partner_free_shipping(total):

expected_findings.description: Loading each customer inside the order loop creates an N+1 query pattern.
The free-shipping threshold is duplicated across three channel helpers.
